title: Mallard Movements
text:
Lake Constance lies in Central Europe, where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet. This site explores GPS fixes from mallards tracked around Radolfzell, on the lake’s western shore; the records span 2007-2017.
Most recorded locations are near the lake, though some tracks extend east across Central and Eastern Europe. GPS fixes are most frequent in September, while recorded speeds are generally higher in summer and early autumn than in winter. Explore locations on the Map and monthly patterns on Seasons.
